cim: The 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence Invite Worldwide Nominations Recognizing Real-World AI Achievements Across Industries
cim_eredeti: The 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence Invite Worldwide Nominations Recognizing Real-World AI Achievements Across Industries
szoveg_eredeti:
Building on more than two decades of recognizing achievements worldwide, the Globee® Awards welcome local, regional, and global accomplishments in AI innovation, implementation, research, products, services, and business applications

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Globee® Awards announced that nominations are now being accepted for the 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence, inviting professionals, teams, departments, companies, and organizations worldwide to nominate real-world AI achievements demonstrating measurable progress across industries.

Learn more and submit nominations at: https://globeeawards.com/artificial-intelligence/

Artificial intelligence continues to introduce new possibilities in research, technology, products, services, and business applications. The Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence recognize achievements in developing, advancing, and applying AI technologies to address challenges, introduce new capabilities, improve experiences, and create meaningful value.

The program welcomes both AI technology providers and organizations implementing AI to enhance products and services, improve customer experiences, support informed decision-making, advance research, strengthen organizational capabilities, and create measurable business value.

Nominations may represent achievements involving generative AI, agentic AI, autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs), multimodal AI, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, conversational AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI infrastructure, AI governance, responsible AI, and AI-powered products, services, and solutions.

Real-world AI achievements are emerging across healthcare, medical technology, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, financial services, banking, insurance, cybersecurity, manufacturing, robotics, retail, education, agriculture, energy, telecommunications, transportation, logistics, aerospace, space technology, professional services, and other industries. Nominations may demonstrate measurable improvements in product and service quality, customer experience, business performance, risk management, scientific discovery, innovation, and organizational advancement.

The Globee® Awards have a history spanning more than two decades, with recognition programs dating back to 2003. Building on this established history of recognizing technology, workplace, and business achievements, the Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence are now in their third annual edition, reflecting the expanding applications of AI across industries and markets worldwide.

The program welcomes achievements by individual professionals, teams, departments, organizations, products and services, and brand, communications, and creative initiatives involving artificial intelligence. Startups, small and medium businesses, established enterprises, research institutions, and other eligible organizations are invited to participate.

Local, regional, and global achievements are welcomed. AI accomplishments do not need worldwide reach to qualify. Meaningful innovations and implementations within a single organization, workplace, industry, or community may also be recognized under applicable award categories.

Entries are evaluated through a merit-based, data-driven process using defined scoring criteria and scores provided by qualified industry professionals. Nominations should describe specific achievements supported by verifiable evidence. Submission of a nomination does not guarantee an award.

The Globee® Awards are organizers of merit-based, data-driven business awards programs with worldwide participation. Across 10 awards programs, the Globee® Awards recognize achievements across multiple industries and sectors. The programs use a structured evaluation approach involving participation from professionals across various industries.
